description: No verified historical AIS for the Ennore 2017 incident has been obtained for this prototype. The tracks in tracks.json are training reconstructions: illustrative positions derived from publicly documented collision coordinates and approximate vessel approach/departure vectors. They exist to demonstrate the PALEGIC attribution workflow and must NEVER be presented as recorded AIS evidence.
ui_display_rule: All tracks in this package must display the label 'Training AIS reconstruction' in the UI. The label 'Recorded AIS' must NOT appear for any track from this package.
swedish_ais_separation_note: The Swedish Gothenburg 2017 recorded AIS dataset (data/source/ais-gothenburg-2017.gpkg) is a separate recorded demonstration dataset. It must NOT be used as a candidate vessel pool for the Ennore investigation.
how_to_obtain_real_ais: MarineTraffic commercial API (historical AIS, paid tier)
Directorate General of Shipping (India) — AIS records under RTI
notes: Replace this provenance block and the tracks when verified historical AIS is obtained. Update provenance_class to RECORDED and is_synthetic to false.
